change.summary: Use one reviewed schema-2 manifest for all 13,869 item IDs, corrected catalog leaves, and exact companion and transport additional views.

modifiers.before: The initial exact manifest retained broad classifier mistakes and had no exact secondary views.
modifiers.after: Every exported item ID has one reviewed primary leaf under the corrected weapon, wearable, food, building, or root tree. Reviewed spawn eggs can also appear in Companions or Transport.

modifiers.before: Armor, mob armor, dolls, tools, sensors, books, and storage items shared one broad leaf.
modifiers.after: Wearables has Armor, Mob Armor, and Dolls leaves. The Dolls leaf contains exact doll item IDs only.

modifiers.before: Many weapons, shields, plants, containers, cooking tools, Create tools, and companion items appeared in Other or an unrelated leaf.
modifiers.after: Reviewed item families use their exact weapon, shield, nature, container, cooking, Create, building-tool, companion, or transport leaf.
Original JEI mode leaves the curated overlay invisible, inactive, and unfocused.

rationale.purpose: Make category membership complete, stable, reviewable, and aligned with actual item purpose.
rationale.user_requested: Correct weapons and shields, add companions and building tools, split armor, move nature, containers, cooking and Create items, and name the dolls leaf Dolls.
rationale.codex_choices: Keep one primary leaf per ID, use exact additional views only for reviewed spawn eggs, and keep doll stations outside the Dolls leaf.

introduced.summary: Install the complete exact registry manifest.

history.summary: Generate and validate 13,869 unique item assignments.
Correct semantic leaves, add Shields, Companions, Building Tools, Armor, Mob Armor, and Dolls, and add exact companion and transport secondary views.

relations: logical server item registry -> checked manifest -> direct client lookup
spawn egg primary leaf -> exact companion or transport additional view
leaf category -> optional JEM Economy admission
notes: The Dolls leaf contains 723 exact doll items.
unresolved: Player visual acceptance requires an explicitly authorized client launch.
